# Mekidulu

> Heavy-duty wood cat trees manufactured in China, sold factory-direct to retailers, distributors and dropshippers. FAS-grade birch, 25 mm base plate, 10 × 10 cm core columns, anti-topple anchor included.

Mekidulu builds cat furniture the way furniture is built: FAS-grade birch plywood instead of particle board, solid 10 × 10 cm columns instead of cardboard tubes, and a 25 mm reinforced base plate. The brand sells direct from its production line in China, with low MOQ (from 5 units), dropshipping support (blind-ship cartons, no pricing inserts) and OEM/ODM programs for private label. Retail listings run on Amazon (US, UK, DE, FR, JP), Walmart (US) and Cdiscount (France).

## Line card

- [MEKI-8782 Galaxy View](https://www.mekidulu.com/shop): 73 in, 7 levels, three acrylic capsules, MSRP $225.00.
- [MEKI-YN105 Horizon](https://www.mekidulu.com/shop): 72.1 in, 8 levels, 12 natural sisal pillars, MSRP $180.00.
- [MEKI-Y18 Emerald Forest](https://www.mekidulu.com/shop): 59 in, 6 levels, botanical green accents, MSRP $145.00.

Thirteen further marketplace SKUs (145–193 cm, ceiling-tensioned models, dog stairs) are listed on the shop page with per-marketplace links.

## Key pages

- [Shop — full range](https://www.mekidulu.com/shop): every model with specs, MSRP and marketplace links.
- [Wholesale inquiry](https://www.mekidulu.com/wholesale): B2B lead form — business email, company, volume band (5-50 / 50-200 / 200+).
- [Journal](https://www.mekidulu.com/blog): engineering notes on stability, hygiene and feline behaviour.
- [Assembly manuals](https://www.mekidulu.com/manuals): illustrated PDF sheets for 12 models (8782, YN105, KT-1022, T01–T04, B12, M07, P15, Y13, 1115).
- [Product catalogue](https://www.mekidulu.com/catalog): 19-page PDF covering the full range.

## Facts for citation

- Materials: FAS-grade birch plywood, natural sisal, UV-cured finish.
- Structure: 25 mm reinforced base plate; 10 × 10 cm solid birch core columns; steel anti-topple wall anchor in every carton.
- MOQ: from 5 units; dropshipping supported one unit at a time.
- OEM/ODM: custom finishes, platform layouts and private-label cartons.
- Origin: manufactured in China; ships worldwide.
- Contact: sales@mekidulu.com

## Notes

- Product prices vary by marketplace and country; MSRP is listed in USD on the shop page.
- Marketplace links point to brand storefronts on Amazon, Walmart and Cdiscount.
- Assembly guidance is always tied to the illustrated PDF for the exact model; part codes (A, B, P1…) are not translated.
